title: Enchantments Encore - Aura Extractor
description: This datapack gives players a command to remove any Aura enchantment from Enchantments Encore from their equipped helmet, and return a book with said enchantment.
body:
This datapack gives players a command to remove any Aura enchantment from [Enchantments Encore](https://modrinth.com/mod/enchantments-encore) from their equipped helmet, and return a book with said enchantment.

To use it in-game, any player can run `/trigger extract_aura`

It checks if the player is wearing the helmet that has the enchantment, and only removes that specific enchantment and ignores the others.
